# Cooked asset loading

The two models, stone textures, short sound, font and scene are unchanged inputs to existing engine tests. No gameplay systems or reference frames are copied.

Readers: og-cook loader, texture, incremental-cook and compression tests; og-runtime model, crowd, garment and raycast tests; engine animation and Basis tests.

Run through the named tests, not as a gameplay template. Asset-only fixtures
have no standalone playtest; their owning tests control the cook and assertions.
